description: v0.1.84 (C369 D1, SDK-API §4.8): the SDK default hold view and summary. For each row, renderHoldView(title, input, schema) gives exactly `view` and `summary` (byte for byte, UTF-8). `dynamic` rows also check line 1: title = `<opTitle>: <entryTitle> (<tool>)`, or `<opTitle>: <tool>` when entryTitle is null. Non-ASCII characters are \u escapes in this file; JSON.parse gives the exact strings. Every SDK runs every row (miniapp-sdk test/hold-view-default.test.ts); this package's test checks the rows against an independent reference renderer.
